items.passage: Many cities have introduced recycling programs, but simply placing bins on street corners does not guarantee results. Residents often do not know which materials are accepted, and contaminated loads end up in landfills anyway. Programs that succeed share one feature: they explain the rules clearly and repeat them often, through signs, school lessons, and local media. In other words, recycling works when people understand it, not merely when the equipment is available.
items.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
options: 재활용 시설을 늘리면 쓰레기 문제가 해결된다.
재활용의 성패는 주민의 이해에 달려 있다.
학교 교육만으로는 재활용률을 높일 수 없다.
지역 언론은 환경 문제를 더 자주 다뤄야 한다.
items.explanation: 마지막 문장 'recycling works when people understand it'이 요지. 성공한 프로그램의 공통점이 규칙을 명확히 설명하는 것이라고 했다.

items.passage: Although the new policy was designed to reduce traffic, it had the ____ effect: more cars appeared downtown than before.
items.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explanation: 'designed to reduce'와 'more cars than before'의 대조가 단서.

vocab_entries.example: A single greasy pizza box can contaminate an entire bin of paper.
Buying new equipment does not guarantee better results.
